plausible_hard.reasoning: A photography teacher works in the visual arts and can naturally be present in an art-school environment; it is easy to imagine them painting a portrait in a studio as part of mixed-media teaching or personal artistic practice, though this is not their core duty.

counter_arguments.argument_for_higher: Because makeup artists already use fine brushes, color theory, and work on detailed facial representations, one could see painting portraits on canvas as a natural extension of their skills, making the scene feel like an unusual but still plausible side of their work (plausible_hard).
